summary.text: Kevin "Coach" Christie, a Democrat from Hartford, has represented Windsor-6 in the Vermont House of Representatives since 2011.
He is the ranking member of the House Committee on Judiciary.

paragraphs.text: Christie was born in Hartford, Connecticut, moved to Hartford, Vermont, in 1973, and graduated from Eastern Connecticut State University, according to his House biography.
He opened an automotive business in Quechee and began coaching track at Hartford High School in 1980.

He taught at the Hartford Technical Career Center from 1986, earned a master's degree in education administration and supervision in 1990, and was named Vermont Technical Education Teacher of the Year in 1992.
In 1994 he became Technical Center Director and Principal at the Randolph Technical Career Center, where he served until 2001.
He has served on the Hartford School Board since 2007 and is its chair.
